name: N-able, Inc.
summary: N-able, Inc. provides unified endpoint management, security operations, and data protection solutions worldwide. The company's solutions enable IT service providers and organizations to drive digital transformation and keep their businesses secure. It also offers a software platform designed to be an integrated enterprise-grade solution that serves as an operating system.
